children: News Corp reported updates to its US$1 billion repurchase program and disclosed daily ASX buy-back activity totaling roughly US$473.6 million to date.
Announces 2025 Repurchase Program authorized to buy up to US$1 billion of Class A and Class B shares.
Daily ASX notifications filed for buys on 11 Sep 2026 and earlier days under the program.
To date the company has repurchased approximately US$473,565,291 of Class A and B shares under the program.
On reported days, total shares bought included 11,844,896 and 5,524,474 with total consideration US$308,114,682.85 and US$162,895,036.21 respectively.
Repurchases are intended to enhance shareholder value; purchases subject to market conditions and may vary.
